test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.

**Statement:**

Prices of pulses have doubled in the last 15 days due to shortages artificially created by large-scale hoarding by a few traders.

**Conclusions:**

I. Hoarding is the only factor that leads to an increase in the price of pulses

II. Fifteen days ago, there was no shortage in availability of pulses

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Given,

Statement:

Prices of pulses have doubled in the last 15 days due to shortages artificially created by large-scale hoarding by a few traders.

Conclusions:

I. Hoarding is the only factor that leads to an increase in the price of pulses - **False** (Because, while hoarding is mentioned as a factor that has led to the price increase, it is not stated that it is the only factor).

II. Fifteen days ago, there was no shortage in availability of pulses - **False** (Because, the statement does not provide any information about the availability of pulses fifteen days ago; it only mentions that prices have doubled in the last 15 days due to current shortages).

So, **Neither conclusion I nor II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
